Game Overview

At its heart, Santa Wheel is a fun game about guide a rolling Santa through Monster Land in an enchanting, precision-driven arcade challenge. With 30 vibrant levels, each offering distinct thrills and heart-stopping obstacles, Santa Wheel promises an addictive festive adventure. Can you help Santa return to the North Pole in time to save Christmas?
